short_bio: American TikTok dancer, the first creator to reach 100 million followers on the platform.
biography:
Charli D’Amelio was born in Norwalk, Connecticut, and trained as a competitive dancer. She began posting dance videos on TikTok in 2019.

Her following grew quickly and in 2020 she became the first person to reach 100 million followers on the app. She and her sister Dixie appeared in the Hulu series The D’Amelio Show (2021).

In 2022 she won the thirty-first season of Dancing with the Stars.
